brief:
Israeli leadership had every reason to anticipate the October 7 attack, according to analysis from Shehab Wire. Hamas's doctrine rejects submission and passivity, the outlet reported, and preceding indicators pointed clearly toward an imminent operation.

All available data before the assault signaled the attack's approach, the analysis suggested, though the account does not detail what specific warnings or intelligence existed beforehand.
dek: Israeli leadership had every reason to anticipate the October 7 attack, according to analysis from Shehab Wire.
title: Israeli leadership should have foreseen October 7 attack, analysis says
